figure.caption: Three decisions taken before any control is chosen, with this case's answer beside each.

items.title: Definition
items.text: Write the diagnostic criteria and the stage before the study begins.
items.case: A histology-confirmed tumour in 20 men, aged 34 to 62.

items.title: Eligibility
items.text: Take newly diagnosed cases within a set period, not old ones.
items.case: Men diagnosed in the last five years, not all the survivors.

items.title: Source
items.text: One hospital is convenient; a registry covers a whole city.
items.case: Two city hospitals, so one surgeon's list is not the whole series.
